column3: Request ids gate correlation; unreadable SQL that might be a write and executed writes without batch size remain uncounted, with their reason reported.
sharpit does not group SQL executions by transaction, so the BootUI transaction grouping limitation is reported and counts remain per request.
Java framework and JDBC batching advice is adapted to SQLAlchemy and DB-API equivalents.
